messages:
jordan: Heads-up: we need to finalize the Dedicated roadmap item for 'surge-safe reservations' — customers want predictable short surge capacity with clear preempt semantics and a simple billing model.

priya: To be specific: baseline reserved capacity + an attachable surge allowance that lasts a short window (20-45s) and is non-preemptible during that window unless there's an extreme overcommit.

oscar: Customers asked for a charge model that's easy to explain to finance. Options: (1) include surge in reservation (higher base price), (2) bill surge at a discounted overflow rate, (3) use borrowable credits. Pref: (2) for launch.

nina: Ops concerns: autoscaler will over-provision if we don't provide a burst shape (arrival curve). We need 95/99 percentile burst length and qps profile from analytics for pilot tenants. Can analytics tag pilot tenants and run the job? @infra-bot

infra-bot: Created job "surge_shape_pilot_v1" for tenants tagged "surge-safe-pilot". Will post daily summaries to #eng-runtime.

jordan: Runtime policy draft (proto-like):

```
surge_reservation {
  baseline_qps: 120
  surge_multiplier: 2.0
  protected_window_sec: 30
  preempt_threshold: 95  // percentile overload threshold
  spill_target: HOSTED_BACKFILL
  billing_policy: OVERFLOW_DISCOUNT
}
```

priya: Add per-tenant flag protected_opt_in (paid) and a grace_ttl that allows extending the window by a short amount with manual ops approval. Also include a soft_billing_cap for pilots.

oscar: Launch criteria proposal: (A) feature flag + unit/integration tests for preempt ordering, (B) APAC canary with 3 pilots for 10 days under synthetic + real traffic, (C) dashboard for spill_tokens, evictions, surge_duration, billing_delta, (D) a runbook with manual extend/evict flow.

nina: Ops wants an emergency drain that maintains fairness across tenants — define fair spill ordering (e.g., longest-running burst first or weighted by tenant priority). Add to spec.

jordan: Decision point: do we include overflow billing at GA or ship behavior-only and flip billing later? I'm leaning to behavior-only GA and enable billing after pilot. It reduces sales friction.

oscar: I disagree — finance teams asked for pricing clarity. If we ship without any overflow billing clause customers may assume it's free. Compromise: ship GA with billing_policy declared as "reserved_rate_by_default" but feature-flagged enforcement off. Docs should be explicit.

priya: Agreed on docs clarity. Action items: priya = write spec + proto + customer-facing FAQ; oscar = work with pricing on overflow_discount numbers and billing soft-cap; nina = runbook + autoscale knobs + canary ops plan; jordan = draft launch checklist and SLA text.

jordan: I'll book a 30m sign-off session Wed. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll lock scope to behavior-first with explicit billing docs and a feature flag to enable enforcement after pilot. :thumbsup:

oscar: I'll start a quick spreadsheet modeling cost for 3 pricing options and share before the sign-off.

priya: Will post spec draft and proto by EOD Mon. Thanks all.
